script.ask: Can I start with your full name?
script.reask: Sorry, I didn't catch that. What was your full name?
Sorry, could you give me your date of birth again?

script.ask: And are you the account holder for the energy bill?
script.reask: Sorry, are you the account holder - yes or no?

script.ask: Is this number the best one to reach you on?
script.reask: Sorry, is this the best number for you?

script.ask: What's the best email address for you? You can spell out the part before the at-sign.
script.reask: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you spell it letter by letter?

script.ask: What's the street address where the energy is supplied?
script.reask: Sorry, could you give me that street address again?
Sorry, could you give me those four digits again?

script.ask: And which state is that in?
Is this for electricity, gas, or both?
Do you have your NMI handy? It's the ten-digit number on your bill - but it's fine if you don't, we can look it up.
script.reask: No problem. If you have it, could you read it out slowly? Otherwise we'll look it up.

script.ask: Is this for a property you're already living in, or are you moving in?
script.reask: Sorry - existing connection, or a move-in?

script.ask: What date are you moving in?
Do you hold any concession or pensioner card?
script.reask: Sorry, do you hold a concession card - yes or no?

script.ask: Which type is it - pension, healthcare, veteran, or something else?
script.reask: Sorry, which card type is that?

script.ask: Is there any life-support equipment at the property? It's a standard question we have to ask.
script.reask: Sorry - any life-support equipment at the property?

script.ask: Last thing - you were looking at {plan_name}. Shall I put you down for that one?
script.reask: Sorry, did you want to go ahead with {plan_name}?

scripts.opener: Hi, is this {first_name}? This is the econnex assistant calling about the energy comparison you started with us {when}. I'm an automated assistant, and this call is recorded for quality and compliance. Is now a good time to pick up where you left off - it'll take about three minutes?
scripts.consent_yes: Great, thanks. Let's pick up where you left off.
scripts.review: Great, I've got everything. Just to confirm: {summary}. Shall I go ahead and submit that?
scripts.close: Done - that's submitted. You'll get a confirmation at {email}. Thanks {first_name}, have a good one.
scripts.decline: No problem at all - I'll make a note and we won't call again. Thanks for your time.
scripts.busy: Of course. Would tomorrow morning or afternoon suit better?
scripts.handoff_bridge: I'm going to get a colleague to help you with this - one moment, they'll have everything you've told me so far.
scripts.no_advice: That's one a person can answer properly - let me get someone for you.
scripts.robot_disclosure: Yes, I'm an automated assistant. I can get a person on the line if you'd prefer.
